dictionary_policy: fixed bbox interior triangle ports; virtual axis normals, not actual CAD faces
bounded_supplement: parent-requested B family supplement after ABC development; not blind/preregistered superiority
pair_point_policy: link2/link3 only: bbox midpoint +/- 0.8*half-extent along longest bbox axis; geometry-only, no label-driven choice

fit.objective: independent split-body six-wrench weighted residuals plus ridge; no direct joint correction
fit.normalization_floor_note: 1 N / 0.1 N*m is a normalization floor, NOT error precision

final_regularizer_selection.partial_rank_policy: only individually full-rank body predictions enter inner loss; all omissions listed

component_passivity_note: independent component passivity is a candidate restriction, NOT a fluid-interference law or a CFD quality filter
